Maintainer ruling — letter **B**.

Source: the maintainer, in the Claude Code review session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01BDtwYUWhLGyWLzYQjZ95Cf` chat on 2026-10-24, verbatim and untranslated: 「13469 移出」

Recorded by that session on the maintainer's instruction (who: the maintainer; what: the quote above; where: the session chat, not GitHub). Per the card's 裁后执行 section, execution is now:

- One os-dev PR deleting `packages/vscode-extension`, its README / docs references and the `ci.yml` comment that lists it among the packages outside the closure; `.changeset` with empty frontmatter is not enough if any published manifest changes — read `scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`'s header. The extension's history stays in git; a separate repository, if wanted later, starts from that history.

Transition applied in the same write: `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue`; the `Ruled:` line is prepended to the body. Dispatch is the objectui `domain:ui` seat's.

Deferral readings · devx seat 3 (#26373) · `session_011GEU2fao9E7fipNbUZo9RL` · 2026-10-27T00:50Z · ⛔ not a claim, no state change

The ruling (B, 移出) is executable, but the surface is under two open PRs right now, so this seat did not claim it this round. Read at `origin/main` 6390fe52:
- **The surface today:** `ui/packages/vscode-extension/` (25 files) plus 41 other files that name `vscode-extension`: `pnpm-lock.yaml`, `skills/objectui/README.md` (`skills/**`, Tier H), root `scripts/check-changeset-fixed.mjs`, `ui/README.md`, `ui/QUICK_REFERENCE.md`, `ui/tsconfig.json`, `ui/content/docs/utilities/{index.md,meta.json,vscode-extension.mdx}`, `ui/content/docs/guide/{architecture,ci-cd-pipeline}.md`, and ui gate scripts and tests under `ui/scripts/**`. The ruling's "`ci.yml` comment" no longer matches on `origin/main`: root `ci.yml` has 0 hits for `vscode-extension`.
- **Overlap:** open PR #26343 (#25712 2g PR 2, the ui-merge epic) touches `ui/packages/vscode-extension/src/__tests__/body-dialect-children-arm-7181.test.ts`, `skills/objectui/README.md`, `ui/README.md`, `ui/QUICK_REFERENCE.md`, `ui/tsconfig.json`, `pnpm-lock.yaml` and `ui/scripts/__tests__/package-files-exist.test.ts`. Open draft PR #26365 (retire `@object-ui/plugin-ai`) touches `pnpm-lock.yaml`, `ui/README.md`, `ui/QUICK_REFERENCE.md`, `ui/packages/plugin-ai/tsconfig.test.json` and three `ui/scripts` files. Dispatch after both land, re-deriving this list from the merged tree.
- **Later collision:** #26080 (ruled A) folds `ui/README.md` and `ui/QUICK_REFERENCE.md` into the root files. Whichever of the two cards goes second edits the other's result.
